title: Welcoming the Migrants
paragraphs: After leaving Makkah, many Muhajirun arrived in Madinah with very little. The Ansar welcomed them into their homes and shared what they had.
One well-known account tells of an Ansari man who offered to share his property with a new brother. The Muhajir thanked him and asked to be shown the market instead.
This support became known as brotherhood between the Muhajirun and the Ansar. It showed care, generosity, and respect for a person's effort.
With support from the community and their own hard work, many migrants rebuilt their lives. Their story teaches that welcoming people is a shared responsibility.
